description: Wastewater Treatment Plants is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. Data regarding wastewater treatment plants with permits issued under the New York State Pollutant Discharge Elimination System. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are treatment, water, facility, spdes, waste. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation. The portal shows 2026-01-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
